claudeStubRules.match: You explain a failed git or GitHub CLI command

structured_output.whatHappened: The push was rejected because the current branch has never been published to origin.
structured_output.likelyCause: main has no upstream branch configured yet.

fixes.label: Push and set upstream
fixes.detail: Publish main and track it on origin.

steps.js: (async () => { await window.__gitgood.actions.addLocalRepository(__REPO_PATH__); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); let code = null; try { await window.__gitgood.invoke('git.push', __REPO_PATH__, { force: false, setUpstream: false, remote: null, branch: null, tags: false }); } catch (err) { window.__gitgood.actions.showError('Push failed', err); code = err && err.info ? err.info.code : null; } await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); const dialog = window.__gitgood.store.get().dialog; const explain = window.__gitgood.store.get().errorExplain; return JSON.stringify({ code, dialogKind: dialog ? dialog.kind : null, autoLoaded: !!(explain.result || explain.loading) }); })()

(async () => { const dialog = window.__gitgood.store.get().dialog; const error = dialog && dialog.kind === 'error' ? dialog.error : null; await window.__gitgood.actions.requestErrorExplanation(error, false); for (let i = 0; i < 40 && window.__gitgood.store.get().errorExplain.loading; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 150)); const s = window.__gitgood.store.get(); const fixes = s.errorExplain.result ? s.errorExplain.result.fixes : []; return JSON.stringify({ explainError: s.errorExplain.error, whatHappened: s.errorExplain.result ? s.errorExplain.result.whatHappened : null, fixActions: fixes.map((f) => f.action) }); })()

(async () => { const fixes = (window.__gitgood.store.get().errorExplain.result || {}).fixes || []; const fix = fixes.find((f) => f.action === 'push-set-upstream'); if (fix) await window.__gitgood.actions.applyErrorFix(fix); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 800)); const status = window.__gitgood.store.get().status; return JSON.stringify({ appliedFix: !!fix, branchName: status ? status.branch.name : null, upstream: status ? status.branch.upstream : null }); })()
